# Лабораторная работа № 4

## Модель «хищник–жертва»

Вариант 58.

x(t) — численность хищников.
y(t) — численность жертв.

Система:

$$
\frac{dx}{dt} = -0.38x + 0.043xy,
$$

$$
\frac{dy}{dt} = 0.36y - 0.052xy.
$$

```{julia}
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"

using DifferentialEquations
using Plots
using DataFrames
using CSV
```

## Параметры модели

```{julia}
a = 0.38
b = 0.043
c = 0.36
d = 0.052
```

Начальные условия

```{julia}
x0 = 6.0
y0 = 23.0

u0 = [x0, y0]

tspan = (0.0, 100.0)
save_step = 0.05

mkpath("data")
mkpath("plots")
```

## Стационарное состояние

Для ненулевого стационарного состояния:

$$
x^* = \frac{c}{d},
\qquad
y^* = \frac{a}{b}.
$$

```{julia}
x_stationary = c / d
y_stationary = a / b

println("Stationary state:")
println("x* = ", x_stationary)
println("y* = ", y_stationary)
```

## Система Лотки–Вольтерры

```{julia}
function predator_prey!(du, u, p, t)
    x, y = u

    du[1] = -a * x + b * x * y
    du[2] =  c * y - d * x * y
end

problem = ODEProblem(
    predator_prey!,
    u0,
    tspan,
)

solution = solve(
    problem,
    Tsit5();
    saveat=save_step,
    abstol=1e-9,
    reltol=1e-9,
)

time = solution.t
predators = getindex.(solution.u, 1)
prey = getindex.(solution.u, 2)
```

## Сохранение данных

```{julia}
results = DataFrame(
    time=time,
    predators=predators,
    prey=prey,
)

CSV.write(
    "data/predator_prey.csv",
    results,
)
```

## Изменение численности популяций

```{julia}
p1 = plot(
    time,
    predators;
    label="Predators x(t)",
    linewidth=2,
    xlabel="Time",
    ylabel="Population",
    title="Predator-prey model",
)

plot!(
    p1,
    time,
    prey;
    label="Prey y(t)",
    linewidth=2,
)

savefig(
    p1,
    "plots/predator_prey_time.png",
)
```

## Phase portrait

```{julia}
p2 = plot(
    prey,
    predators;
    label="Phase trajectory",
    linewidth=2,
    xlabel="Population жертв y",
    ylabel="Population хищников x",
    title="Phase portrait",
)

scatter!(
    p2,
    [y_stationary],
    [x_stationary];
    label="Stationary point",
    markersize=6,
)

savefig(
    p2,
    "plots/predator_prey_phase.png",
)
```
